source_text: Rursus exponit his qui habent aures ad audiendum de porta. Mysterium Domini transeuntis — ecclesiae custodia. Gloria Christo Iesu in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Again he expounds to those who have ears for hearing concerning the gate. Mystery of the Lord passing through — the church’s custody. Glory to Christ Jesus forever. Amen.
pass_b_english: Again for [[those who have ears to hear >> Bible:Matthew 11:15]]: the Lord’s passing seals the gate — a mystery kept for the church. Glory to Christ Jesus forever. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
